patch.value: Detect existing duplicate items with calibrated pair decisions

Add bounded title and body lexical candidates, sequential typed pair verification, abstention and explicit SDK apply/close receipts. Measure lexical and local model arms on public duplicate closures with held-out labels.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: preserve pre-create title screening; add bounded pair scanning over certified complete SDK reads, sequential noul verification, a symmetric abstain band, and explicit apply/close authorization with receipts. Evaluate public tracker-copy duplicate closures versus lexical hard controls, using disjoint duplicate groups and a maximum of 200 pairs per local model arm. Canonical checkouts and external data remain read-only.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented real-SDK pair scans and mutation guards. Focused pair regressions pass, including abstention, confidence authorization, explicit close gating, receipt history, read-only scans and model-unavailable refusal. Public evaluation inventory: 29 verified public copies; 2 skipped before tracker reads. Strict resolvable labels yield 35 positives (31 historical consolidation receipts plus 4 standard closures), paired with 70 lexical controls. Duplicate-group hashing separates dev and held-out items; retrieval misses count as false negatives. Calls run sequentially under nice.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Independent behavioral revert proofs: disabling only the positive probability cutoff makes the real-tracker apply regression fail (duplicate versus abstain); forcing closure without checking the extra close flag makes it fail (closed versus open). Source restored byte-for-byte; the same focused test passes 1/1. Command: node --test --test-name-pattern="pair apply writes only above threshold" test/dedupe.test.ts. Threshold selection is dev-F1 with a 0.8 model floor; this is an operating-point calibration, not a 95% precision guarantee. Lexical controls are closed-world labels and may contain unrecorded duplicates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Real-label held-out evaluation: 24 pairs (8 positives,16 lexical controls), dev 81 (27/54); 35 real positive closures overall, 8 retrieval misses overall and 1 held out. Lexical: precision 30.4%, recall 87.5%, F1 45.2%, abstain 0%, 62.0 ms/pair. tev1:0.8b: precision 46.2%, recall 75.0%, F1 57.1%, abstain 41.7%, 892.5 ms/pair. tev1:4b: precision/recall/F1 62.5%, abstain 16.7%, 5571.7 ms/pair. Wilson intervals and F1 envelope are in README and calibration/dedupe-report-v1.json. Total elapsed 810.5 s; 107 sequential calls/model including an excluded identical-text control and a counted replacement repetition after postprocessing failure. Cutoffs use dev-F1, 0.8 model floor, three positive predictions and one true positive. Controls remain closed-world labels; small correlated samples and weak precision preclude a readiness claim.

value.text: Packed CLI dogfood: pm --json jev dedupe --status open returned 20 rows on the copied public pm-github tracker using real tev1:4b. The final candidate implementation reproduces every packed-run pair after the exact-text fallback correction; all 105 benchmark pairs/scores also remain identical. Normal-home health sees an existing global pm-github host-version skew; isolated CI identity is used for package gates.
